<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// Keepsoft demo seed - QuoteFlow. Imports 3 example calculators and 13 realistic AU leads.
global $wpdb;
add_filter('pre_wp_mail','__return_true');
$ids=[]; foreach(['plumbing','cleaning','lawn'] as $s){ $ids[$s]=QuoteFlow_Examples::import($s); }
mt_srand(7);
$people=[['Jess Alvarez','jess.alvarez@bigpond.com','0412 553 018'],['Tom Nguyen','tom.nguyen@outlook.com','0423 901 774'],['Sophie Marshall','sophie@marshallbuilders.com.au','0409 226 531'],['Liam O\'Connor','liam.oconnor@gmail.com','0431 118 902'],['Priya Raman','priya.raman@icloud.com','0417 660 245'],['Callum Bishop','callum@bishopelectrical.com.au','0402 884 317'],['Hannah Whitfield','hannah.w@yahoo.com.au','0438 771 509'],['Daniel Kowalski','dkowalski@westgate.net.au','0415 392 668'],['Mia Thompson','mia.thompson@gmail.com','0426 540 193'],['Ben Carter','ben@carterandco.com.au','0408 713 220'],['Olivia Tran','olivia.tran@outlook.com','0419 835 446'],['Jack Sutherland','jack.sutherland@gmail.com','0432 209 857']];
$n=0;
foreach($ids as $s=>$fid){ $post=get_post($fid); $cfg=QuoteFlow_Form::get($fid);
 $count=$s==='plumbing'?5:4;
 for($i=0;$i<$count;$i++){ $a=[];
  foreach($cfg['fields'] as $f){ $id=$f['id'];
   if(in_array($f['type'],['number','slider'])){ $a[$id]=mt_rand((int)$f['min'],(int)max($f['min'],min($f['max'],$f['min']+4))); }
   elseif(in_array($f['type'],['select','radio'])){ $a[$id]=mt_rand(0,count($f['options'])-1); }
   elseif($f['type']==='checkbox'||$f['type']==='checkboxes'){ $a[$id]=[0]; if(count($f['options'])>1&&mt_rand(0,1)) $a[$id][]=1; }
   else { $a[$id]=''; } }
  $c=QuoteFlow_Calc::calculate($cfg,$a); if(is_wp_error($c)){ continue; }
  $pp=$people[$n%count($people)]; $n++;
  $id=QuoteFlow_Leads::insert(['form_id'=>$fid,'form_title'=>$post->post_title,'name'=>$pp[0],'email'=>$pp[1],'phone'=>$pp[2],'answers'=>$c['answers'],'subtotal'=>$c['subtotal'],'tax'=>$c['tax'],'total'=>$c['total'],'currency'=>$cfg['currency'],'summary'=>'']);
  $wpdb->update(QuoteFlow_Install::table(),['created_at'=>gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',time()-($n*5400+mt_rand(0,3000)))],['id'=>$id]);
 }}
$pg=wp_insert_post(['post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>'Get an instant quote','post_name'=>'quote','post_content'=>'[quoteflow id="'.$ids['plumbing'].'"]']);
wp_insert_post(['post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>'Cleaning quote','post_name'=>'cleaning-quote','post_content'=>'[quoteflow id="'.$ids['cleaning'].'"]']);
wp_insert_post(['post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>'Lawn quote','post_name'=>'lawn-quote','post_content'=>'[quoteflow id="'.$ids['lawn'].'"]']);
update_option('show_on_front','page'); update_option('page_on_front',$pg);
update_option('keepsoft_demo_forms',$ids);
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/'); flush_rewrite_rules();
